mapper.select: SELECT a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, a.type AS account_type, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(posted.debit_amount), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS totalDebit, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(posted.credit_amount), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS totalCredit FROM account a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.account_id, l.debit_amount, l.credit_amount FROM journal_entry_line l JOIN journal_entry je ON je.id = l.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status = 'POSTED' ) posted ON posted.account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.code, a.name, a.type ORDER BY a.code
